descriptions.rgb: The five frames show a compact bicycle workshop, with tiled floor below, benches and storage bins along the far wall, and several bicycles and stands occupying the center and sides. A man in a dark gray shirt remains roughly 1–2 m in front of the camera wearer, generally facing away or downward toward a bicycle and never clearly looking toward the camera; nearby bicycles are within about 0.5–1 m of him. The camera wearer’s hands, forearms, and a bicycle handlebar or wheel intermittently appear at the lower edge within arm’s reach, while another bicycle is about 0.5–1.5 m to the left or directly ahead and partly occludes the floor and furniture. Across the sequence, the viewpoint rotates and shifts rightward and downward, moving from a view dominated by bicycles on the left and center toward the workbench, chair, and bike components on the right; the man consequently moves from upper center-right toward upper left in the image without a clear large change in distance. Chairs, bins, tools, and work surfaces lie roughly 1–3 m ahead around the room perimeter, with many objects partially hidden behind bicycle frames or cropped by the top, bottom, and side edges.
